title: memory-hub event envelope
description: Shared append-only event envelope for the Jz-Plugin v4.0 memory/log loop. Single write entry (mem_write.py), sharded by `type` into issue-log.jsonl / evolution-log.jsonl. This file is the SPEC; validate_logs.py enforces an equivalent subset in pure stdlib (no jsonschema dependency).

id.description: Stable record id. Convention: ISSUE-<skill>-<NNN> or EVO-<skill>-<NNN>. Also the CQI join key.

type.description: Shard selector. issue -> issue-log.jsonl ; evolution -> evolution-log.jsonl

evidence.description: Verbatim original wording / transcript pointer / runtime trace. For user-correction events, preserve the original text, not a summary.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp WITH timezone offset, e.g. 2026-06-04T13:40:00+08:00. Must be parseable by datetime.fromisoformat.

requester.description: Who triggered the record (defaults to `source` when omitted).

source_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the implicated skill file, when a specific SKILL.md is in scope.

trigger.description: What kind of event produced this record.

skill_version.description: SemVer of the target skill at record time.

payload.description: Type-specific fields. issue: { implicated_rule, change_type? }. evolution: { change_type, validation_score, changelog_ref }.
